https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/base-power/578a:
ABOUT BASE

Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time.




ABOUT THE ROLE

The Fleet Health Team turns telemetry from our device fleet into clear answers and action. You'll investigate how our devices behave in the field, work out why something went wrong and whether it's a hardware or a firmware issue, and make sure the right people fix it.

You'll work closely with our firmware team, follow fixes through firmware iterations, and translate highly technical findings into crisp, actionable updates for leadership and engineering. This role sits at the intersection of software engineering, embedded systems and analytics: you don't need to be an embedded engineer, but you'll read firmware code, understand what it does, and build the tooling that makes this work faster.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own week-over-week analysis of device alerts. Review the cases flagged as non-nominal operation and dig into telemetry to understand why they happened.

 - Root-cause issues down to hardware vs. firmware using sensor data, telemetry and logs, tag them accordingly, and route them to the right owner to fix.

 - Track firmware iteration cycles for the fixes we're driving, sit in on firmware reviews, and stay current on our embedded codebase.

 - Distill complex technical findings into simple, actionable summaries for leaders, and keep engineers and stakeholders aligned on status, closing the loop like a technical program manager.

 - Build tooling around our device and telemetry systems that makes analysis faster and easier.

 - Take on exploratory analysis for other high-priority questions, such as billing, as they come up.




WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - A background in electrical engineering and/or computer science (EECS), ideally a combination of both.

 - You can read an embedded/firmware codebase and functionally understand what it does, where things could break, and what the solution space is. Prior embedded work experience isn't required, and you don't need deep expertise in specific microprocessors.

 - You're comfortable going into telemetry and logs to do root cause analysis.

 - You write good, maintainable code and like building tools, not just running analyses.

 - You understand statistical methods well enough to judge them, and you question results, including AI-generated analysis, rather than taking output at face value.

 - You explain complex technical findings simply and clearly, to executives and engineers alike.

Nice to Have

 - Experience building software or tooling for IoT or connected devices.

 - Understanding of battery management systems and electrochemistry

 - Competency in Engineering Performance Systems Modeling




ABOUT THE TEAM

The Engineering Fleet Health Team is a budding team within the Base Power Platform team, responsible for defining, managing, improving, and ensuring excellent fleet performance for both internal trading and utility partners. Your work on this team would directly move the needle of one of the most important company missions: make Base Core the best battery storage product on the market. This is a highly visible and impactful position, with scope to grow as our product lines mature, partnerships increase in volume, and product suite increases.



Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive.




OUR VALUES

 - First Principles Thinking: Question assumptions. Principles > rules.

 - Operate at Base Pace: Focus on what matters, act quickly, and learn by doing.

 - Give & Get Feedback: Be direct, be humble, and maintain a growth mindset.

 - Everyone’s an Owner: Follow through on commitments and own results.

 - Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: Drive clarity and make calls with imperfect information.

 - Committed to the Mission: Rebuilding the grid is a big challenge. We work hard because we care deeply about the impact we’re creating. We work in-person. It’s not a 9-to-5. We are all-in.

 - Fun & Optimism Coexist with Grit: Collaboration and celebration coincide with the intensity of building real things.
   
   


DO THE BEST WORK OF YOUR LIFE AT BASE.
